structured.approach: I read both contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.design) to find any storage needs for the Data Science lane (TSK-03, TSK-04 in ap_forecast). Then I checked the repository directly: I listed its files, searched it for database and migration terms, and read predict.py and explain.py. The design puts storage, databases and schema migration out of scope, and the repository has no database, so no database change is required and the outcome is met. The output path already held an earlier draft labelled 'attempt 3' that ended with a stray tool-result line. I read it first, then replaced it with a clean attempt-1 file. I could not run shell commands (the G9 hook blocks Bash for DS-03), so I used Glob, Grep and Read instead.

claims.text: The feature design lists 'Storage, database, schema migration' as out of this design; in-scope data is in-memory structures plus the CT-1 JSON.
DD-1: no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage; only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
NF-10: every new function is pure and in-memory, with no I/O, no network and no mutation of inputs.
The Data Science lane tasks are TSK-03 (vendor_risk, no LLM, no network, no models.json read) and TSK-04 (build_explanation_request risk=None, models.json must not change).
ap_forecast is at package version 0.9.0 today; its version step is owned by TSK-03 (a package version, not a schema version).
ap_forecast has no database; no migrations exist or are required.
The ap_forecast source holds only __init__.py, explain.py, predict.py and models.json, and a search for database or migration terms found no match.
build_explanation_request reads only the packaged models.json configuration through load_config(); predict_delay_days is a pure computation over the given history.
Adding storage or a network call to the libraries would reopen DES-01; the design triggers none.

structured.summary: DS-03 is done and needs no database work. The design puts storage, databases and schema migration out of scope, and every new function is pure and in-memory. The repository has no database, migrations or SQL. So TSK-03 and TSK-04 need nothing from DBAs or infrastructure. The output is written to task.db_changes.md. It replaces an earlier draft at that path, labelled 'attempt 3', which ended with a stray tool-result line. The output also lists the conditions that would require re-running this check, such as persisting risk results or production wiring (DQ-1) adding a store. There are no new open questions.

tool_input.command: cd run/workspace; git -C ap_forecast ls-files; grep -rniE "sqlite|sqlalchemy|psycopg|migrat|database|CREATE TABLE|\.sql\b" ap_forecast --include='*' -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^ap_forecast/.git/'; echo "---"; ls agents/hobasa-data-science-agent/outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600/ 2>/dev/null
tool_input.description: List repo files, search for database usage, list prior outputs
